resources.string: Indlela yokwamkela okanye yokwala imisebenzi yokonakala kwezithuthi eyabelwe liCandelo Lothumelo.

INYATHELO 1: Vula iDashboard yakho yeTekhnishini uze ucofe ku Ukonakala Okusebenzayo.
INYATHELO 2: Jonga inkcazelo yokonakala oyabelweyo, inombolo yobhaliso yelori kunye nendawo ekuyo.
INYATHELO 3: Cofa u Yamkela Umsebenzi (okutshintsha isimo sakho sibe ku Endleleni) okanye u Yala Umsebenzi (unike isizathu sokuba iCandelo Lothumelo labele omnye).
INYATHELO 4: Cofa u Ukhokelo Lwemephu ukuqalisa isikhokelo sendlela esiya kwindawo ekonakele kuyo isithuthi.
Uhlolo Lokhuseleko Lwasecaleni Kwendlela & Nokudlulisela Phambili
Uhlolo lokhuseleko olunyanzeliswayo lwendawo phambi kokuqala umsebenzi wokulungisa.

INYATHELO 1: Wakufika kwindawo ekonakele kuyo isithuthi, cofa u Uhlolo Lokhuseleko.
INYATHELO 2: Hlola izithuthi ezisendleleni, ukubekwa koonxantathu besilumkiso kunye nokuzinza komhlaba.
INYATHELO 3: Khangela iPPE (ibhatyi neebhutsi) kunye nezithinteli zamavili zesithuthi.
INYATHELO 4: Ukuba kukhuselekile, thumela ukuze uqhubeke. Ukuba AKUKHUSELEKANGA, vula u Akukhuselekanga ukuze uthumele isilumkiso esikhawulezileyo kwiCandelo Lothumelo.
Fumanisa iingxaki, qikelela ixesha lomsebenzi & neentsimbi, uze uthumele ikowuteshini ukuze ivunywe nguMlawuli.

INYATHELO 1: Cofa u Uvavanyo & Nekowuteshini kwikhadi lomsebenzi.
INYATHELO 2: Gcwalisa iinkcukacha zelori (Uhlobo/Imodeli, iVIN, iOdometer, neenkcukacha zeNjini).
INYATHELO 3: Bhala ingxaki efunyenweyo, unobangela kunye neziphumo zovavanyo.
INYATHELO 4: Faka iiyure zomsebenzi eziqikelelweyo, ixabiso leentsimbi kunye neendleko zohambo.
INYATHELO 5: Cofa u Bala Ikhowuteshini Iyonke kunye no Thumela Uvavanyo & Nekowuteshini. Linda isaziso semvume yoMlawuli phambi kokuqala umsebenzi.
Papasha uhlaziyo lwamanqanaba omsebenzi kunye nexesha elitsha lokugqiba (ETA).

INYATHELO 1: Cofa u Ingxelo Yenkqubela kwikhadi lomsebenzi elisebenzayo.
INYATHELO 2: Khetha inqanaba lenkqubela (umz. Imibhobho Yomoya Ihlambulukile, Amagumbi Eziqhoboshi Atshintshiwe).
INYATHELO 3: Faka inkcazelo yenkqubela kunye nexesha elitsha lokugqiba (ETA).
INYATHELO 4: Cofa u Papasha Uhlaziyo Lwenkqubela ukuze wazise iCandelo Lothumelo kunye noMthengi.
Bhala iintsimbi ezisetyenzisiweyo uze ucele imvume yeendleko ezongezelelweyo.

INYATHELO 1: Cofa u Iintsimbi & Nemvume.\nINYATHELO 2: Faka igama lentsimbi, inombolo yentsimbi yeOEM kunye nenani elisetyenzisiweyo kwikhadi lomsebenzi.\nINYATHELO 3: Ukuba kufunyenwe omnye umsebenzi ongaphezulu kobekucetyiwe, gcwalisa ifomu yeSicelo Somsebenzi Owongezelelweyo uze uyithumele kuMlawuli ukuze ivunywe.
Phawula ulungiso olungaphumelelanga okanye izikhalazo ukuze kubuyelwe emsebenzini.

INYATHELO 1: Ukuba ulungiso alukwazi ukugqitywa okanye aluphumelelanga, cofa u Phawula Ukubuyela.\nINYATHELO 2: Khetha isizathu sokuphawula (Ulungiso Aluphumelelanga, Kufuneka Ingcali, Iintsimbi Azifumaneki, njl.).\nINYATHELO 3: Nika iinkcukacha ezicacileyo uze uthumele kwiCandelo Lothumelo.
Indlela yokufaka isicelo sokonakala kwesithuthi kunye nokuncamathisela indawo ekuyo.

INYATHELO 1: Vula iDashboard yoMthengi uze ucofe ku Cela Uncedo Lwasecaleni Kwendlela.
INYATHELO 2: Faka inombolo yobhaliso yelori uze uchaze ingxaki yokonakala.
INYATHELO 3: Cofa u Thatha Ifoto Yengxaki ukuze ufumane ubungqina.
INYATHELO 4: Cofa u Ncamathisela Indawo Yam Yephini ukusebenzisa iGPS okanye ukhethe indawo kwimephu.
INYATHELO 5: Cofa u Thumela Isicelo Soncedo.
Ukwabiwa Kwetekhnishini Ngexesha Lokwenyani & Nokulandelela IETA
Landelela ukufika kwetekhnishini eyabelweyo uze uvume iikowuteshini zokulungisa.

INYATHELO 1: Vula iDashboard yoMthengi uze ucofe ku Imbali Yezicelo Zam.\nINYATHELO 2: Jonga igama letekhnishini eyabelweyo, iinkcukacha zoqhagamshelwano, isimo kunye nexesha lokufika (ETA).\nINYATHELO 3: Xa ikowuteshini ithunyelwe yitekhnishini, cofa isicelo sakho ukuze ujonge uze uvume ikowuteshini.
Cofa iqhosha leSOS elikwikona ephezulu ngasekunene kuso nasiphi na isikrini. Qinisekisa isilumkiso ukuze wazise iCandelo Lothumelo kunye neetekhnishini ezikufutshane ngokukhawuleza.
Ukusebenzisa iAI ukuxilonga iingxaki zobugcisa zeelori.
Cofa u UMncedisi WeAI kwiDashboard yeTekhnishini. Buza imibuzo malunga nokulahleka koxinzelelo lweziqhoboshi zomoya, iikhowudi zeempazamo zeCummins/Volvo SPN, okanye uvavanyo lweWABCO ABS.
Ukusebenza kwiindawo ezikude ezingenayo inethiwekhi yeselula.

Lonke uhlolo lokhuseleko, amakhadi omsebenzi, uvavanyo kunye nohlaziyo lwenkqubela zigcinwa kwifowuni kwiSQLite xa kungekho ntanethi. Iirekhodi zingqamaniswa ngokuzenzekelayo kwiCandelo Lothumelo wakuba uqhagamshelwano lubuyile.
Indlela yokuxilonga ukulahleka koxinzelelo lweziqhoboshi zomoya kwilori enzima?
Yintoni impazamo yeSPN 651 FMI 5 Injector Cylinder 1 kwaye ilungiswa njani?
Zivavanywa njani iivalvu zeWabco ABS Modulator kunye neesensa zesantya sevili?

INKQUBO YOKUXILONGA IZIQHOBOSHI ZOMOYA:
1. Khangela uxinzelelo oluphuma kwiAir Compressor & noseto lweGovernor (uqhelo lwecut-out yi-120-135 PSI).
2. Yenza uvavanyo lokuvuza: Beka izithinteli zamavili, khulula isiqhoboshi sasentwasahlobo, pompa inkqubo iye kwi-100 PSI, ujonge igeyiji umzuzu omnye (ukwehla okungaphezulu kwe-2 PSI kwilori enye, i-3 PSI kwidibaniselwano).
3. Hlola iAir Dryer purge valve & neFour-Circuit Protection Valve ukuze ubone izithintelo okanye ukukrazuka.
4. Khangela iFoot Brake Valve & neRelay Valve exhaust ports ukuba ayivuzi na ngokuqhubekayo.

UKUXILONGA IKhowudi YEMPAZAMO YENJINI YEDIESEL (SPN 651 / INJECTOR CIRCUIT):
1. I-SPN 651 FMI 5 ibonisa iOpen Circuit / High Resistance kwiInjector #1 Solenoid.
2. Khangela iintambo ezidlula kwivalve cover ukuba azinawo na amafutha okanye iipini ezixegayo.
3. Linganisa ukumelana kweInjector Solenoid: Uluhlu olulindelekileyo yi-0.2 ukuya kwi-1.5 Ohms. Ukumelana okungaphezulu kwe-2.0 Ohms kubonisa ikhoyili eyonakeleyo.
4. Khangela uqhagamshelwano lweentambo phakathi kweECM Pin 15 & neInjector Pin A.

UKUXILONGA IWABCO ABS MODULATOR & NESENSA:
1. Khangela isikhewu somoya seWheel Speed Sensor: Tyhala isensa ide ichukumise itone wheel; ukujikeleza kwevili kuzilungisela isikhewu.
2. Uvavanyo lokumelana: Ukumelana kwesensa yeWABCO kufuneka kube yi-900 - 2000 Ohms.
3. Vavanya iiSolenoids zeModulator Valve: Ukumelana phakathi kweepini zeInlet/Outlet kufuneka kube yi-12-18 Ohms.
4. Qinisekisa umbane we-24V oya kwiABS ECU.

UMYALELO WOKHUSELEKO LWASECALENI KWENDLELA:
1. Misa isithuthi ecaleni lendlela elizinzileyo. Layita izibane zengozi.
2. Beka Oonxantathu Besilumkiso kwi-45m, 90m, kunye ne-150m emva kwesithuthi esonakeleyo.
3. Ibhatyi ebonakalayo neebhutsi zokhuseleko ZINYAZELISIWE.
4. Beka izithinteli kumavili elori phambi kokungena phantsi kwesithuthi.

UNCEDO LOBUGCISA LWEELLORI NGOKUBANZI:
Ngombuzo othi: %1$s
1. Hlola uqhagamshelwano oluphambili loomatshini/lombane.
2. Yenza uskeno lweOBD usebenzisa isixhobo sokuxilonga iilori ezinzima.
3. Jonga iNcwadi yeNkonzo yeOEM & neMithetho yoKhuseleko yePE Airbrakes.
4. Ukuba kukho ingozi, thumela iSafety Escalation kuMlawuli weCandelo Lothumelo ngokukhawuleza.

Molo! NdinguMncedisi wakho weAI weTekhnishini. Ndibuze nantoni na malunga neenkqubo zeziqhoboshi zezithuthi ezinkulu, ukuxilongwa kweenjini zediesel, iikhowudi zeempazamo zeSPN/FMI, okanye imigangatho yokhuseleko lwasecaleni kwendlela.
